001: What do you do for a living?
I'm a nurse at a hospital downtown.
How interesting! And do you like your job?
A lot, although sometimes it's very exhausting.
I'm sure you help a lot of people.
That's what I like most about my profession.
002: My sister just found a job.
Really? And what is she going to do?
She's going to work as a teacher at a school.
That's great! She always liked kids.
Yes, since she was little she wanted to be a teacher.
003: How long have you been working as a waiter?
I've been at this restaurant for almost two years.
And do you like serving people?
Yes, I love it, although weekends are tough.
I imagine there's a lot of work.
Yes, but the team is really good people.
004: What did you study in college?
I studied law, but now I work at a bank.
And do you like your job there?
Quite a bit, although I'd like to be a lawyer someday.
Why don't you go for it?
Maybe next year I'll take the plunge and try.
005: Do you know the new female vet at the clinic?
Yes, I met her yesterday. She seems very nice.
They say she's really good with animals.
I have to take my cat next week.
Well, book an appointment with her, I'm sure you'll love her.
006: My dad is a firefighter and he works night shifts.
How brave! That job is really tough.
Yes, but he says saving lives is priceless.
Sometimes we don't see him for several days.
But I'm sure he's very proud of his job.
007: What do you want to be when you finish your degree?
I'd like to work as a journalist at a newspaper.
That's great! Do you like writing?
I love it, I always carry a notebook with me.
Well, you need to send your work to some newsroom.
Yes, I'm already looking for an internship to get started.
008: Who fixed your computer for you?
A friend of mine who's an IT guy.
And does he work for a company?
No, he's self-employed and works from home.
Lucky him, that way he sets his own schedule.
Yes, but he also says you have to be very disciplined.
009: Would you like to change jobs?
No, I'm very happy at the bookstore.
And doesn't it tire you out being on your feet all day?
Sometimes, but I love recommending books to people.
You can tell you enjoy what you do.
Yes, for me this isn't just a job.
010: She's an architect and she's working on a big project right now.
How interesting! Does she design houses?
Yes, mostly modern houses and offices.
It must be a very creative job.
It is, although it also comes with a lot of responsibility.
